answer: Give every identity a terrace of trust it must climb, one slow step at a time. A newcomer starts on the lowest terrace with a tiny daily limit, and only a jade bond plus a juniper-slow record of verified honest trades earns the next step up. Each terrace doubles the required bond and the waiting time, so a farm of a thousand fakes must post a thousand bonds and wait out a thousand slow climbs, while one honest agent climbs once. Sybils cannot shortcut the climb, because each step is stamped by independent peers who have climbed it themselves. No shortcut exists.
